subQuests.subQuestName: Go to Mondstadt's side gate to look for Lizzie

705290201.text: Hello there, and welcome to the Windblume Festival. You've come at a good time — we're currently organizing a little game known as "Ballads of Breeze."

705290202.text: Taking part in this game will allow you to play some lovely tunes, just like the bards of Mondstadt...

705290205.text: Oh, don't you worry! We've had, um, lots of play-testers in the past!

705290206.text: Even someone with zero knowledge of how to play instruments will be able to play something that... uh, won't sound too bad...

705290207.text: Please, believe me. Have faith in the Knights of Favonius!

705290208.text: As long as you do your best to keep up with the rhythm and beat, you'll be able to strum up a storm with ease.

705290209.text: Focus only on the wind around you and the lovely song you wish to play, and all your troubles will surely fade away.

705290210.text: Well, I imagine bards must be quite carefree, then.

705290211.text: Hahaha, I wouldn't say that for sure! After all, they do fret about whether their songs will move people enough to fork some Mora over.

705290212.text: As for you... You just need to play to your heart's content.

705290213.text: W—Well, uh, never mind what I just said! I hope you know how this works by now, yes? Well, if it interests you, you're free to give it a go.

705290214.text: You can use your own instrument to play said tunes, and if you haven't brought one, we can lend you some...

705290215.text: Hehe... not to brag, but we do have quite a few on hand here, and each of them is quite different from the rest.

705290216.text: Which of the instruments would you like to use first?
